annotations.title: Request a meeting or event space

description: Use this when the person needs a meeting room or event space that one booking link cannot carry: several days (each with its own times and headcount), several rooms at the same time, a seating layout, catering or equipment — e.g. a 2-day workshop for 20 with a projector and lunch, or two rooms in parallel for interviews. One room on one day: get_booking_links. A regular slot (every week, every second Monday) is a monthly membership: request_office_quotes with inquiry_type monthly_membership. Before calling, read the whole request back to the person — days, times, people, rooms, layout, catering, equipment, budget, spaces — and get their yes; only after they agreed to share name, company and email. No guest list. Pass up to 3 venue slugs from search_venues (the first is asked first), or only a city. Nothing reaches a space yet: the person gets a 6-digit code by email — then call confirm_email_code. The space and One Coworking confirm availability and price by email; this call books nothing.

budget_total_eur.description: For the whole booking in EUR, not per hour or per day.

company.description: The company, or "private" for an individual.

consent.description: true: the person agreed that One Coworking stores these details and passes the request to spaces for them.

days.description: One row per day, all within a month: e.g. Tue 12:00–18:00 for 20, Wed 08:00–14:00 for 20.

to.description: End, HH:MM (24 h), after the start.

must_haves.description: Anything else the space must offer, in the person's words — e.g. step-free access, vegetarian lunch. No names, company or contact details.

near.description: A street, station or district to be near, in the person's words. No names or contact details.

rooms.description: Rooms needed at the same time — 2 for parallel interviews, 5 for a plenary and four breakouts.
